app.offline: Uni VPN is not running. Restart the computer.
setup.find_help: Not in the list? Choose "Not listed" and enter the VPN address from your university's IT help pages.
setup.choose: Choose your university, or Not listed
setup.saml: Your university signs in through a web page. Uni VPN can't do that yet.
setup.sign_in_sub: Your university account, the same as for email.
setup.enter_user: Enter your username, for example ab123
setup.totp_sub: Add this computer like a second phone that shows sign-in codes.
setup.totp_help: No line starting with otpauth://? Copy the letters after "secret=" instead. Codes on your phone keep working.
setup.generic_step.1: Open your university's {portal} and add a new code generator (often called TOTP) for this computer.
setup.generic_step.2: Copy the line starting with otpauth://, or the letters after secret=.
setup.waiting: Testing the connection. This can take a minute.
setup.all_set_sub: University websites now open through the VPN by themselves. Close and reopen your browser once.
setup.all_set_no_domains: Add the websites that should go through the university under Settings, Websites.
setup.fix_config: The settings file has a mistake: {error}
main.hint.idle: Connects by itself when you open a university website.
main.hint.connected: University websites go through the VPN.
settings.title: Settings
settings.domains_help: One website per line, for example uni-heidelberg.de. Its pages are included. All other websites stay as they are.
state.config_error: The settings file has a mistake: {error}
state.port_in_use: Another program is in the way. Restart the computer.
state.wintun_admin: Install Uni VPN again to finish setting it up
state.blocked: Cisco Secure Client is connected, so Uni VPN is paused
state.offline: No internet, or the Wi-Fi wants you to sign in first
state.otp_wait: Waiting for the next code (up to 30 seconds)
state.keyring_locked: The computer's password storage is locked. Unlock it and try again
state.totp_unreadable: The saved setup key can't be read. Enter it again
state.password_encoding: Your password has a character Uni VPN can't send. Change the password
state.openconnect_start: Uni VPN couldn't start. Install it again
state.login_failed_exit: Sign-in failed. Details under Settings, Log
state.idle_disconnect: Not used for a while, disconnecting
tunnel.totp_rejected: Code rejected. Check the computer's time, or enter the setup key again
tunnel.append_rejected: Sign-in rejected. Check your password, then the computer's time
tunnel.duo_rejected: Sign-in rejected. Check your password, and approve the request on your phone in time
tunnel.auth_rejected: Sign-in rejected. Check your password. If it's right, your university asked for something Uni VPN doesn't know (details under Settings, Log)
tunnel.saml: Your university signs in through a web page. Uni VPN can't do that yet
tunnel.hostscan: Your university checks the computer before it lets it in. Uni VPN can't do that
tunnel.totp_invalid: The setup key doesn't work. Enter it again
tunnel.certificate: The university's server can't be trusted right now
totp.line_break: The key must be on one line
totp.only_totp: This key is not for time-based codes. Choose the time-based one (TOTP)
totp.algorithm: This kind of key isn't supported
totp.not_secret: That's not the setup key. Copy the line starting with otpauth://, or the letters after secret=
totp.incomplete: The key is incomplete. Copy the whole line
totp.base32: That's not a valid setup key
password.line_break: The password must be on one line
address.invalid: Enter the VPN address, for example vpn.example.edu
address.path: After the / the address may only contain letters, numbers and . _ ~ + -
detect.not_cisco: This is not a Cisco VPN address
detect.not_cisco_http: This is not a Cisco VPN address
detect.no_form: This address doesn't ask for a sign-in
